facts.fact: The Uganda Registration Services Bureau reports that in FY 2023/24 it added 13 accounts on its National Marriage Register System, bringing the total to 624, held by district Chief Administrative Officers and places of worship among others, and trained CAOs on the system in eight districts; it gives no count of CAO accounts and does not say where or over what connection CAOs use them.
facts.system: District Chief Administrative Officers' accounts on the National Marriage Register System
